GR32_Transforms>TNestedTransformation>ClearMethod

TNestedTransformation.Clear

Removes and frees all transformation items from the chain.

Declaration ​

pascal
procedure Clear;

Description ​

Empties the nested transformation chain and frees all contained transformation objects.
